summary_1line: Arjuna receives Indra’s celestial chariot and weapons, journeys to the demons’ city, and begins a massive battle against the Nivata-Kavachas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra places a radiant diadem on Arjuna’s head as Matali waits beside a blazing celestial chariot with peacock‑down banners.
Arjuna blows the conch Devadatta before the underground demon city as thousands of armored Danavas gather with weapons behind their gates.
Arjuna’s chariot races across the battlefield while Matali drives the divine horses and arrows from the Gandiva rain down upon the Nivata-Kavachas.
